Subject: PO fields + payment cadence question

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one from procurement as we finalize the PO for the upcoming pilot: our ERP requires a PO header that includes the Redwood invoice cadence (monthly/weekly), the remit-to entity, and the purchase category code. Our AP team also flags vendors that issue invoices more than twice per month unless there is pre-authorized staggered billing on the PO.

Can you confirm if Redwood can: 1) accept a PO that lists a "staggered billing" clause (we'd like three invoice releases per month), and 2) provide a short pre-authorization memo we can attach to the PO so AP will process monthly payments against multiple invoices?

We also have a standard Net60 request for this account. If Net60 is not available, please advise alternatives since our legal prefers Net60 for pilot contracts.

Thanks,
Maya Sullivan
Procurement Lead, HealthGrid

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear note and the template.

Short answer: we can support a 3x-per-month invoice release on a PO provided two things are in place: (A) the PO explicitly states "staggered invoice releases permitted up to 3 per month" and (B) a pre-authorization note from Redwood that references the PO ID and the agreed Net term.

Options we can offer today:
- Net30 standard (no discount).
- Net45 with a 2% early-pay discount (if HealthGrid commits to a quarterly prepaid minimum).
- Net60 considered on a case-by-case basis for enterprise agreements; requires finance sign-off and a purchase-commitment schedule.

If Net60 is required for the pilot only, we can do a conditional acceptance with an invoice holdback of up to two invoices until the initial onboarding fee clears. That keeps exposure limited while giving your AP the Net60 flow.

I'll loop in finance for a quick sign-off on the Net60 exception and draft the short pre-authorization memo you can attach.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed with finance. Practical proposal:

1) Approve staggered billing up to 3 invoices/month. AP must include PO ID + incremental invoice suffix in the invoice header for automatic posting.

2) Net terms: offer Net45 standard.
   - Net60 may be granted for this pilot if HealthGrid signs a payment guarantee (commitment letter) or prepays the onboarding fee (we can convert that to a credit).

3) Holdback mechanism: allow first two onboarding-related invoices to be marked as "contingent" (we will treat them as provisional until onboarding completion). After onboarding acceptance, those invoices convert to standard status and clear on agreed terms. This limits credit exposure.

4) Discount: if they lock a 12-month committed spend band at the time of the PO, offer a 7% volume discount; otherwise standard pricing applies.

Priyom, happy to do the formal credit exception if you approve the above.

—Vivek
VP Finance
Redwood Inference
